paragraphs: I'm Abdallah Sabri, a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with over 15 years of experience building web systems, leading engineering teams, and turning complex problems into scalable, maintainable software.

My career has spanned government portals, travel tech, civic analytics, and healthcare SaaS. I've worked inside large enterprise environments and scrappy startup teams, and I've been on both sides of the table as an engineer and as a founder.

In late 2024, I launched Clincura, an AI-powered clinic management SaaS, and in May 2026, I launched Level Feedback, a reputation management platform for small businesses. Building these products from zero taught me something no job ever did: how to talk directly to users, understand what they actually need, and turn that into software that solves a real problem.
I'm based in Ramallah, Palestine, and actively looking for remote opportunities or roles that would allow me to relocate, particularly in Europe.

When I'm not building software, I'm investing in people. I currently serve as President of Afaq Toastmasters Club, helping others grow their communication and leadership skills. I also volunteer as Secretary and Board Member of Silwad Students Association, managing administrative operations, supporting university community initiatives, and making sure student voices are heard and acted upon.
